news.subject: Choir News - September 14, 2026
news.html:
Hello BBC Choir!

EVENING CHOIR PRACTICES starting Oct. 4 - We will continue to have our evening choir practices in the chapel on Sept. 20 and 27, but starting Oct. 4, we will move to the auditorium until the end of December while the practice for the Children's Christmas Musical is in the chapel.

DENDLERS ON VACATION

At rehearsal last night, I mentioned that Beth and I will be out-of-town Sept. 27 and Oct. 4.

Joe Moody and Mike Wright are filling in for me while we are gone.  We will still have evening choir practices at 5:15pm those evenings.  Beth and I will be back on Sunday, October 11.  A BIG THANKS to Joe and Mike for filling in!

Thank you for your faithfulness!
